customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Misty Shoal, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>You catch sight of Columbina in the distance on a deserted island on the east side of Piramida. Worried that your friend has encountered trouble, you chase after her, and in so doing, embark on an adventure into the unknown...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We've never been here before. Where is this, exactly?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Look! That person over there...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Columbina?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Why's she here? Paimon thought she'd be at Silvermoon Hall...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Heh, funny how life works sometimes. Let's go over and say hi!
Quest Objective: Say hello to Columbina
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! Columbina! Where are you going!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Agh, she's gone too far out. She can't hear us.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But what's she doing here? Does she have something to do?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Let's follow her and take a look.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah. Paimon doesn't think she'll run into any trouble, but better safe than sorry.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Let's go!
Quest Objective: Follow Columbina
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Look! Is that an island up ahead?
<color=#ece5d8>Dunanna Forward Station, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Well, whaddya know, there really is a lil' island here... Could this have been Columbina's destination?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Let's have a look around. Hopefully, we'll find her soon.
Quest Objective: Look for traces of Columbina
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Where are those kuuhenki going?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Do you think they saw Columbina? Come on, let's follow them!
(Approach the lake)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wow, there's a pretty little lake if Paimon's ever seen one.
(Approach the Secret Source Automaton)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa! This... looks like one of the dragons' Secret Source Automatons! Could this place have something to do with them?
(Approach the ground passage)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Look! There's an entrance leading down here... Should we go down and check it out?
Quest Objective: Pass through the entrance
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm. Why do these rocks look kinda... floaty?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> There's tons of broken machines in here... and none of them are ones we've ever seen before, either...
(Pass further)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It's those floating rocks again! Do you think we can push them out of the way?
Quest Objective: Explore the underground ruins
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> This place looks like some sort of ruins...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh. What are those rings? Looks like they've fallen onto the ground or something.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Some kinda device, I'd say.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Is that so? In that case, could this glowing sign next to it... be a manual, maybe?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Let Paimon see...
<color=#ffffff>Alert! Alert!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, darn it! Paimon triggered some kinda intruder alarm!
<color=#ffffff>Alert! Alert!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Power transmission has ceased. Please head to</color> <color=#ffe04b>the generator room</color> <color=#ffffff>to activate backup power!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, so it's just out of power! Gah, Paimon almost jumped outta her skin!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Reminds me of you when you're hungry, you know?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What? C—C'mon, Paimon's way classier than that!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Let's go check this generator room out first.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> You mean...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ohh, right! If Columbina came here to do something, she'd totally need to turn on the power first.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Right, and we might find her there.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Haha, genius!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alrighty then! Let's go!
Quest Objective: Head to the generator room
(Approach the broken mechanisms)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Seems like this thing's gone kaput.
(Enter the generator room)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> This must be the generator room.
(Approach the mechanism)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh. This thing... doesn't really look very mechanical, but given where we found it, it must be the key to getting the power on somehow.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But Paimon doesn't see how that's supposed to work...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> It doesn't look like the power's been turned on yet.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah, and that's super weird. Do you think Columbina's already been here? Maybe she discovered that the power wouldn't start, and went to look for a solution elsewhere?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm. Y'know what? Let's give this thing a try anyway. Maybe we can find out what's going on...
Quest Objective: Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Why isn't anything happening?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: It won't start.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: There's no response.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon guessed as much... There's gotta be something else to this. Columbina must have run into this problem and then gone to look somewhere else... Huh!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> C—Columbina!? Thank goodness, we finally found you!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe... Surprised to see us? We were worried you might be in trouble, so we followed you here.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Do you need help, Columbina?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Erm...
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> ...What's wrong? Are you trying to use telepathy, like Nicole? Just so you know, we aren't hearing anything!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Are you alright?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Okay, now you're starting to worry Paimon...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Is someone threatening you!? If that's the case, just blink...
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? What did you do?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Do you want us to activate this?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon's not sure what's going on, but it looks like Columbina wants us to activate this device. We should give it another try!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> You can use the power Columbina just gave you to activate this thing, right?
(Launch Archaeolune Ripples towards the generator)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ooh! The device reacted this time!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But these things on the ground... They're for transferring energy, right? We gotta figure out a way to get them flowing again.
Quest Objective: Talk to Columbina
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Awesome! The energy channels are clear! How did you do that, Columbina?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait! Where are you going?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We'd better catch up with her.
Quest Objective: Return to the hall
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Look! The three rings that fell to the ground... Wow, they look pretty fancy now, don't they?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It's like going out for a bit and coming back to find your little house has suddenly turned into the Dawn Winery!
(Approach Columbina)
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Trilune coordinates!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait, so this device is used to work out where the moons are?
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: "Eternal Moon"</color>
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Connection lost... Failed to locate target...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: "Iridescent Moon"</color>
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Connection lost... Failed to locate target...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: "Frost Moon"</color>
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Connecting... Target located.
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color>

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa, it actually found the Frost Moon... But why would they need those coordinates anyways?

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Frost Moon coordinates located. Base engineering blueprints and Main Control Hall route map have been transmitted.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ooh! These look like schematics! Whatever these are showing, it looks super awesome!
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Do you wish to obtain the route map?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> (Obtain route map)
<color=#ffffff>Celestial Orbit:</color> Please proceed to the Main Control Hall for moon landing preparations.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> M—Moon landing preparations!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Columbina... is this place used for getting to the moon!?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> (But Columbina has taken me to the Frost Moon before... Why would she need this device?)
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> (And the power she just gave me is completely new. I've never seen her use it before...)
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh! The door opened! This leads to the Main Control Hall, right? Columbina, is that where you want us to go?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Columbina, can you hold out your hand?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Place it in mine, just like we do in Silvermoon Hall.
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What's all this about?
<color=#ffffff>Columbina:</color> !
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Waaah! What's going on? Columbina turned into a black kuuhenki!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> That's not Columbina!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What!? An impostor!?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Let's go after her!
Quest Objective: Follow the black kuuhenki
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What's going on!? Why did that black kuuhenki look just like Columbina!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We gotta hurry up and catch it!
(Activate the lift)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What's that? Looks like something we saw in the blueprint just now.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Look! There's the kuuhenki over there!
(Pass further)
<color=#ffffff>Intruder detected. Initiating alert!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It thinks we're intruders!? Did that black kuuhenki do this!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Traveler, watch out!
(Pass further)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We're being targeted again! Take cover on the left!
(Follow kuuhenki)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Look! She's ducked behind the door!
(Go through the door)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Where are we now? That kuuhenki must've come in here, right?
(Activate the Gravimeter)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa! What's going on? How did you manage to jump so high!?
(Deactivate the Gravimeter)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Everything's back to normal... Was it simulating the moon's gravity just now? Looks like they really were preparing for a moon landing.
Quest Objective: Enter the main control hall to search for the black kuuhenki
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> According to the route map, this should be the Main Control Hall, right?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! You! The one pretending to be Columbina! Come out right now!
<color=#ffffff>Main Control Terminal:</color> Alert! Intruder detected in Main Control Hall. Activating defense measures.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wah! Sorry! Wrong address, we were looking for someone else!
Quest Objective: Defeat the guards
Quest Objective: Check the Celestial Orbit
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew... It was no problem for you in the end! That should take care of things, right?
<color=#ffffff>Main Control Terminal:</color> Alert! Main Control Hall Defender Core destruction confirmed. Initiating self-destruct mode.
<color=#ffffff>Main Control Terminal:</color> All personnel, please evacuate immediately. Initiating countdown...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Seriously!? This base has gone crazy! It's trying to take us down with it... What should we do?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What if some really important intel gets destroyed!?
<color=#ffffff>Main Control Terminal:</color> Please verify orbital coordinates.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? What orbital coordinates? Whoa! Our mystery kuuhenki's back!
<color=#ffffff>Mysterious Kuuhenki:</color> !
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What are you doing? Will giving it the coordinates stop the base from self-destructing!?
<color=#ffffff>Mysterious Kuuhenki:</color> !!!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What are the coordinates? Don't panic, don't panic, let Paimon think!
<color=#ffffff>Main Control Terminal:</color> Please verify orbital coordinates.

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa, we blasted off for real! Paimon was expecting a regular ol' vanilla adventure... but here we are flying to the moon!

<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Can't you speak yourself?
<color=#ffffff>Mysterious Kuuhenki:</color> !
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh, that's weird...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Then how about... we take a look around this ship? Let's see if we can find something to help you talk.
